sections.title: Passage A - Moxie on Mars (火星制氧设备)
raw_text: A small device, Moxie, has produced oxygen on the surface of Mars, 1. ________ (bring) the chances of surviving on the red planet a step closer.

Research published in 2. ________ journal *Science Advances* reported that Moxie produced breathable oxygen in seven-hour-long tests conducted in various weather and atmospheric(大气的) conditions last year.
The research also found that even in extreme 3. ________ (temperature) and after a Martian dust storm, Moxie 4. ________ (continue) to produce high-purity oxygen.

"This is the first demonstration of actually using resources on the surface of Mars and transforming 5. ________ (they) chemically into something useful for a human mission," Jeffrey Hoffman, a 6. ________ (retire) astronaut, said.
"The thin atmosphere on Mars is 96 percent carbon dioxide and much more 7. ________ (change) than on Earth and the temperature can vary by 100 degrees," Hoffman said.
"One aim is to show we can run Moxie in all seasons."
The device, Moxie, uses some special pumps, 8. ________ suck in carbon dioxide.
The gas 9. ________ (heat) to 800°C and pressed to separate the carbon and oxygen.
Carbon monoxide is sent out as waste while the pure oxygen is left behind.
Despite the challenges, Moxie has proved durable in the extreme conditions on Mars and scientists regard the test results 10. ________ a great achievement.
filled_text: A small device, Moxie, has produced oxygen on the surface of Mars, bringing the chances of surviving on the red planet a step closer.
Research published in the journal Science Advances reported that Moxie produced breathable oxygen in seven-hour-long tests conducted in various weather and atmospheric conditions last year.
The research also found that even in extreme temperatures and after a Martian dust storm, Moxie continued to produce high-purity oxygen.

"This is the first demonstration of actually using resources on the surface of Mars and transforming them chemically into something useful for a human mission," Jeffrey Hoffman, a retired astronaut, said.
"The thin atmosphere on Mars is 96 percent carbon dioxide and much more changeable than on Earth and the temperature can vary by 100 degrees," Hoffman said.
"One aim is to show we can run Moxie in all seasons."
The device, Moxie, uses some special pumps, which suck in carbon dioxide.
The gas is heated to 800°C and pressed to separate the carbon and oxygen.
Carbon monoxide is sent out as waste while the pure oxygen is left behind.
Despite the challenges, Moxie has proved durable in the extreme conditions on Mars and scientists regard the test results as a great achievement.
filled_text_cn: 一个名为 Moxie 的小型装置在火星表面制造出了氧气，使在这颗红色星球上生存的希望更近了一步。
发表在《科学进展》杂志上的研究报告称，Moxie 在去年各种天气和大气的条件下进行的为期七小时的测试中，制造出了可供呼吸的氧气。
研究还发现，即使在极端温度下以及火星沙尘暴过后，Moxie 仍继续制造高纯度氧气。
“这是首次实际利用火星表面资源并将其通过化学方式转化为对人类太空任务有用的物质的实证，”退役宇航员杰弗里·霍夫曼说。
“火星上稀薄的大气中96%是二氧化碳，并且比地球上多变得多，温差可达100摄氏度，”霍夫曼说。
“一个目标是证明我们可以在所有季节运行 Moxie。”
Moxie 这个装置使用了一些特殊的泵，它们可以吸入二氧化碳。
气体被加热到800°C并加压，从而将碳和氧分离。
一氧化碳作为废气排出，而纯氧则被留存下来。
尽管面临挑战，Moxie 已被证明在火星的极端条件下经久耐用，科学家们将这一测试结果视为一项伟大成就。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：现在分词作结果状语
questions.explanation: 句意：小型设备Moxie在火星表面制氧，从而使在这颗红色星球上生存的机会更近了一步。此处用现在分词 bringing 作自然而然产生的结果状语。故填 bringing。
questions.rule_summary: 表示句子动作顺理成章带来的必然结果时，常使用现在分词 -ing 作结果状语。

questions.grammar_point_name: 定冠词 (the)
questions.explanation: 句意：发表在《科学进展》期刊上的研究报告……此处特指后文名为 Science Advances 的特定期刊，故使用定冠词 the。故填 the。
questions.rule_summary: 特指后文有具体名称或修饰语限定的名词时用定冠词 the。

questions.grammar_point_name: 可数名词变复数
questions.explanation: 句意：研究还发现，即使在极端温度下……temperature 表示不同情况下的温度时为可数名词，此处 extreme 修饰泛指各种极端温度环境，用复数形式 temperatures。故填 temperatures。
questions.rule_summary: temperature 表泛指各种温度条件时常以复数形式 temperatures 出现。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词时态（一般过去时）
questions.explanation: 句意：Moxie 继续生产出高纯度氧气。根据主句谓语'The research also found that...'可知叙述过去发生的测试情况，从句谓语动词用一般过去时 continued。故填 continued。
questions.rule_summary: 叙述过去完成的科学测试过程，主从句时态呼应，用一般过去时。

questions.grammar_point_name: 人称代词主格变宾格
questions.explanation: 句意：并将其通过化学方式转化为对人类任务有用的东西。transforming 为动词，其后跟人称代词作宾语，代指前文的 resources，用宾格 them。故填 them。
questions.rule_summary: 及物动词或介词后作宾语时，人称代词用宾格形式。

questions.grammar_point_name: 动词派生形容词（过去分词作定语）
questions.explanation: 句意：退役宇航员杰弗里·霍夫曼说。修饰名词 astronaut 作定语，表示“已退役的”，用过去分词形式的形容词 retired。故填 retired。
questions.rule_summary: 不及物动词的过去分词可以表示动作已完成，常作前置定语修饰名词（如 retired astronaut）。

questions.grammar_point_name: 动词派生形容词
questions.explanation: 句意：火星上稀薄的大气……比地球上多变得多。be 动词后接形容词作表语，changeable 表示“易变的，多变的”，与 much more 构成比较级。故填 changeable。
questions.rule_summary: 动词 change 后加后缀 -able 构成形容词 changeable，意为“多变的，易变的”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非限制性定语从句关系代词 (which)
questions.explanation: 句意：Moxie装置使用了一些特殊的泵，它们可以吸入二氧化碳。逗号后为非限制性定语从句，先行词是物 pumps，在从句中作主语，只能用 which。故填 which。
questions.rule_summary: 非限制性定语从句先行词为物且在从句中充当主语时，关系代词只能用 which（不用 that）。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（一般现在时的被动语态）
questions.explanation: 句意：气体被加热到800°C并加压以分离碳和氧。此处描述装置的客观工作原理，主语 The gas 与 heat 为被动关系，与后文 pressed 并列，构成一般现在时的被动语态 is heated。故填 is heated。
questions.rule_summary: 客观科学原理或工作机制采用一般现在时，主语承受动作时用 be + done 构成被动语态。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定搭配 (regard ... as)
questions.explanation: 句意：科学家们将这一测试结果视为一项巨大成就。regard ... as ... 为固定搭配，意为“把……看作/视为……”。故填 as。
questions.rule_summary: regard ... as ... 是常见动词固定搭配，意为“将……视作……”。

sections.title: Passage B - The Yi's New Year (彝族年)
raw_text: The Yi's New Year is a popular festival for the Yi ethnic group (彝族) in Sichuan, Yunnan, Guizhou and Guangxi.
It 11. ________ (fall) on a day around November 20th every year.
There are many traditional practices (惯例) of the festival.
When the festival comes near, the Yi people will start house cleaning.
They think that cleaning can help them wash away bad things in the house and bring good luck 12. ________ them.
They also put firewood in front of their houses.
They believe that 13. ________ height of the firewood is a symbol of a happy life in the new year.
It also shows the hard work they 14. ________ (do) in the past year.
On the eve of the Yi's New Year, family members come together 15. ________ (enjoy) a big dinner.
On the day of the festival, the young Yi people wear 16. ________ (they) ethnic dresses and go to a mountainside.
They join in many activities of the local New Year.
Moerqin, a seesaw-like (像跷跷板一样的) swing activity, is one of 17. ________ (popular) games among the Yi people.
New Year's activities would not be complete without visiting 18. ________ (relative) and friends.
The Yi people usually prepare gifts such as meat, drinks, and other things when they go for a visit.
The Yi people love these practices 19. ________ (deep) and have been trying to pass them down (世代相传).
These practices show the Yi people's way of life 20. ________ their good wishes for a better life.
filled_text: The Yi's New Year is a popular festival for the Yi ethnic group in Sichuan, Yunnan, Guizhou and Guangxi.
It falls on a day around November 20th every year.
There are many traditional practices of the festival.
When the festival comes near, the Yi people will start house cleaning.
They think that cleaning can help them wash away bad things in the house and bring good luck to them.
They also put firewood in front of their houses.
They believe that the height of the firewood is a symbol of a happy life in the new year.
It also shows the hard work they did in the past year.
On the eve of the Yi's New Year, family members come together to enjoy a big dinner.
On the day of the festival, the young Yi people wear their ethnic dresses and go to a mountainside.
They join in many activities of the local New Year.
Moerqin, a seesaw-like swing activity, is one of the most popular games among the Yi people.
New Year's activities would not be complete without visiting relatives and friends.
The Yi people usually prepare gifts such as meat, drinks, and other things when they go for a visit.
The Yi people love these practices deeply and have been trying to pass them down.
These practices show the Yi people's way of life and their good wishes for a better life.
filled_text_cn: 彝族年是四川、云南、贵州和广西彝族同胞喜爱的节日。
它每年在11月20日左右的一天到来。
该节日有许多传统习俗。
当节日临近时，彝族人民会开始打扫房屋。
他们认为大扫除可以帮助洗去屋里的坏运气，并给他们带来好运。
他们还会在屋前摆放柴火。
他们相信柴火的高度是新一年幸福生活的象征。
它也展示了他们在过去一年中所付出的辛勤劳动。
在彝族年除夕，家人团聚在一起享用丰盛的晚餐。
在节日当天，彝族年轻人穿上他们的民族服装前往山坡上。
他们参加当地庆祝新年的许多活动。
“磨尔秋”，一种类似跷跷板的秋千活动，是彝族人民中最受欢迎的游戏之一。
如果不拜访亲朋好友，新年的活动就不算完整。
彝族同胞在走亲访友时，通常会准备肉类、饮品等礼物。
彝族人民深深地热爱着这些习俗，并一直努力将它们世代相传。
这些习俗展现了彝族人民的生活方式以及他们对美好生活的祝愿。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词时态与主谓一致（一般现在时第三人称单数）
questions.explanation: 句意：它每年在11月20日左右到来。根据'every year'可知描述客观习惯规律，主语 It 为单数第三人称，动词用第三人称单数形式 falls。故填 falls。
questions.rule_summary: 表示周期性发生的客观节日时间，用一般现在时，第三人称单数主语谓语加 -s。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词搭配 (bring sth. to sb.)
questions.explanation: 句意：并给他们带来好运。bring sth. to sb. 为固定搭配，意为“给某人带来某物”。故填 to。
questions.rule_summary: bring ... to sb. 意为“把……带来给某人”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 定冠词 (the)
questions.explanation: 句意：他们相信柴火的高度是新一年幸福生活的象征。此处'the height of the firewood'特指柴火的高度，名词 height 前需用定冠词 the。故填 the。
questions.rule_summary: 名词后有 of 短语修饰表示特指时，前面加定冠词 the。

questions.grammar_point_name: 定语从句谓语时态（一般过去时）
questions.explanation: 句意：这也展示了他们在过去一年中所付出的辛勤劳动。从句定语修饰 hard work，时间状语为 in the past year，动作发生在过去，谓语动词用过去式 did。故填 did。
questions.rule_summary: 描述过去一年中已经完成的劳动，从句时态用一般过去时 did。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：动词不定式作目的状语
questions.explanation: 句意：在彝族年除夕，家庭成员聚在一起享用丰盛的晚餐。come together to do sth.，此处用不定式 to enjoy 表目的。故填 to enjoy。
questions.rule_summary: 动词不定式 to do 常置于句中充当目的状语，表示“为了做……”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 形容词性物主代词
questions.explanation: 句意：彝族年轻人穿上他们的民族服装。修饰名词短语 ethnic dresses，需用形容词性物主代词 their。故填 their。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰名词作定语时，人称代词要转换为形容词性物主代词形式。

questions.grammar_point_name: 形容词最高级 (one of the most + adj.)
questions.explanation: 句意：“磨尔秋”是彝族人民中最受欢迎的游戏之一。固定句型“one of the + 形容词最高级 + 复数名词”，popular 为多音节形容词，最高级为 the most popular。故填 the most popular。
questions.rule_summary: 句型“one of the + 形容词最高级 + 复数名词”表示“最……的之一”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 可数名词变复数
questions.explanation: 句意：新年的活动如果不拜访亲戚和朋友就不算完整。relative 意为“亲戚”，是可数名词，与后文复数名词 friends 并列，表泛指，用复数形式 relatives。故填 relatives。
questions.rule_summary: 可数名词与复数名词并列且表泛指时，使用复数形式。

questions.grammar_point_name: 形容词变副词 (修饰动词)
questions.explanation: 句意：彝族人民深深地热爱着这些习俗。修饰实义动词 love，应用副词 deeply 作状语，表示程度深。故填 deeply。
questions.rule_summary: 形容词 deep 后加 -ly 构成副词 deeply，用以修饰情感类动词如 love, moved 等。

questions.grammar_point_name: 并列连词 (and)
questions.explanation: 句意：这些习俗展现了彝族人民的生活方式以及他们对美好生活的祝愿。连接两个并列的宾语名词短语 way of life 和 their good wishes，表示顺承并列关系，用连词 and。故填 and。
questions.rule_summary: 连接两个地位平等的名词短语表示并列递进时，使用并列连词 and。

sections.title: Passage C - Horse-Faced Skirt & Neo-Chinese Style (马面裙)
raw_text: Is there anyone around you wearing a horse-faced skirt?
It is a type of hanfu, the traditional style of clothing of the Han people.
It is now getting so popular 21. ________ some people wear it daily.
22. ________ March 6, a Douyin report showed that the order for horse-faced skirts 23. ________ (go) up by 841 percent compared to the past year.
As hanfu becomes popular, traditional and modern fashions are coming together.
This has influenced not only clothing styles but also 24. ________ (people) cultural ideas.
Some hanfu lovers think that each design of hanfu has its own cultural 25. ________ (mean).
They believe these should be 26. ________ (strict) followed.
However, other buyers think 27. ________ (beautiful) and comfort are more important.
Zhou Shuang, 37, designs character outfits (服装) for film and television.
She pointed out that for those 28. ________ don't know much about traditional clothing, it's understandable that they want to mix ancient beauty and modern fashion.
This is known as the neo-Chinese style.
"Neo-Chinese style clothing doesn't only use traditional elements.
It puts together modernity and tradition naturally," said Zhou.
She added that it shows that traditional beauty should 29. ________ (value) by Chinese people today.
"I've noticed that there are so many people wearing horse-faced skirts on the streets now, from young women to children.
It's unbelievable," said Wang Zicheng, 30. ________ 23-year-old hanfu lover.
filled_text: Is there anyone around you wearing a horse-faced skirt?
It is a type of hanfu, the traditional style of clothing of the Han people.
It is now getting so popular that some people wear it daily.
On March 6, a Douyin report showed that the order for horse-faced skirts went up by 841 percent compared to the past year.
As hanfu becomes popular, traditional and modern fashions are coming together.
This has influenced not only clothing styles but also people's cultural ideas.
Some hanfu lovers think that each design of hanfu has its own cultural meaning.
They believe these should be strictly followed.
However, other buyers think beauty and comfort are more important.
Zhou Shuang, 37, designs character outfits for film and television.
She pointed out that for those who don't know much about traditional clothing, it's understandable that they want to mix ancient beauty and modern fashion.
This is known as the neo-Chinese style.
"Neo-Chinese style clothing doesn't only use traditional elements.
It puts together modernity and tradition naturally," said Zhou.
She added that it shows that traditional beauty should be valued by Chinese people today.
"I've noticed that there are so many people wearing horse-faced skirts on the streets now, from young women to children.
It's unbelievable," said Wang Zicheng, a 23-year-old hanfu lover.
filled_text_cn: 你身边有人穿马面裙吗？
它是汉服的一种，是汉族的传统服饰风格。
它现在变得如此流行，以至于有些人每天都穿着它。
3月6日，一份抖音报告显示，马面裙的订单量比去年增长了841%。
随着汉服的走红，传统与现代时尚正走到一起。
这不仅影响了服装风格，还影响了人们的文化观念。
一些汉服爱好者认为汉服的每一种形制都有其自身的文化内涵。
他们认为这些规矩应该被严格遵守。
然而，其他买家则认为美观和舒适更为重要。
37岁的周双为影视作品设计人物服装。
她指出，对于那些不太了解传统服饰的人来说，想要将古代美感与现代时尚相融合是可以理解的。
这被称为“新中式”风格。
“新中式服装不仅仅使用传统元素。
它很自然地把现代感和传统结合在了一起，”周双说。
她补充说，这表明传统之美在今天应该受到中国人民的重视。
“我注意到现在街上有很多人穿着马面裙，从年轻女性到小孩子都有。
这太令人难以置信了，”23岁的汉服爱好者王子成说。

questions.grammar_point_name: 结果状语从句连词 (so ... that)
questions.explanation: 句意：它现在变得如此流行，以至于有些人每天都穿。固定结构 so + adj. + that ... 引导结果状语从句，意为“如此……以至于……”。故填 that。
questions.rule_summary: so ... that ... 是引导结果状语从句的经典连词搭配。

questions.grammar_point_name: 具体日期的介词 (on)
questions.explanation: 句意：在3月6日，一份抖音报告显示……在具体的某一天（March 6）前用介词 on，首字母大写。故填 On。
questions.rule_summary: 在具体的某月某日或具体某一天前，时间介词使用 on。

questions.grammar_point_name: 宾语从句谓语动词时态（一般过去时）
questions.explanation: 句意：订单量上涨了841%。主句谓语动词 showed 为一般过去时，从句动作也发生在过去，谓语动词 go 用过去式 went。故填 went。
questions.rule_summary: 主句谓语为一般过去时，宾语从句通常使用过去的相应时态。

questions.grammar_point_name: 名词所有格
questions.explanation: 句意：这不仅影响了服装风格，还影响了人们的文化观念。修饰名词短语 cultural ideas，表示“人们的”，people 本身是复数名词，加 's 构成名词所有格 people's。故填 people's。
questions.rule_summary: 不规则复数名词（如 people, children, men）的所有格形式直接加 's。

questions.grammar_point_name: 动词派生名词 (mean -> meaning)
questions.explanation: 句意：汉服的每一种设计都有其自身的文化内涵。形容词 cultural 修饰名词，动词 mean 的名词形式为 meaning，意为“意义，内涵”。故填 meaning。
questions.rule_summary: 动词 mean 后接 -ing 转化为抽象名词 meaning，意为“含义，意义”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 形容词变副词 (修饰动词分词)
questions.explanation: 句意：他们认为这些规矩应该被严格遵守。修饰被动语态中的动词分词 followed，需用副词 strictly。故填 strictly。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰动词、过去分词或被动语态谓语时，用副词修饰。

questions.grammar_point_name: 形容词派生名词 (beautiful -> beauty)
questions.explanation: 句意：然而其他买家认为美观和舒适更重要。与不可数名词 comfort 并列作从句主语，需用形容词 beautiful 的名词形式 beauty。故填 beauty。
questions.rule_summary: 形容词 beautiful 对应的名词形式是 beauty，意为“美丽，美观”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 定语从句关系代词 (who)
questions.explanation: 句意：她指出，对于那些对传统服饰不太了解的人……先行词 those 指代人，在定语从句中作主语，关系代词用 who。故填 who。
questions.rule_summary: 先行词 those 指代人并在从句中作主语时，定语从句关系代词首选 who。

questions.grammar_point_name: 含情态动词的被动语态 (should be valued)
questions.explanation: 句意：传统之美在今天应该受到中国人民的重视。主语 traditional beauty 与 value 为被动关系，情态动词 should 后接动词原形 be，构成 should be valued。故填 be valued。
questions.rule_summary: 情态动词（should, can, must 等）后构成被动语态时结构为“情态动词 + be + 过去分词”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 不定冠词 (a)
questions.explanation: 句意：23岁的汉服爱好者王子成说。此处泛指“一名23岁的汉服爱好者”，23-year-old 的读音以辅音音素 /t/（twenty）开头，用不定冠词 a。故填 a。
questions.rule_summary: 单数名词前表泛指且以辅音音素开头的复合形容词修饰时，使用不定冠词 a。

sections.title: Passage D - The Brush Pen (毛笔)
raw_text: The brush pen, one of the "Four Treasures of the Study", was invented thousands of years ago.
It is 31. ________ (old) than the other three treasures.
It was widely used in ancient China for writing and painting.
Even today, it 32. ________ (play) an important role in Chinese culture.
With the rapid development of modern technology, however, fewer people use it in their daily life.
To pass down the tradition, many schools in China have offered calligraphy (书法) classes to students 33. ________ the past few years.
Students are encouraged 34. ________ (practice) Chinese calligraphy.
It is believed that calligraphy can not only improve students' writing skills, 35. ________ also help them learn more about Chinese traditional culture and calm their minds down.
In this way, students can have a 36. ________ (well) understanding of the Chinese culture.
Besides, the government has also made great efforts to protect the skills of 37. ________ (make) brush pens.
Making a brush pen takes a lot of time and effort.
The brush part is usually made of animal hair, such 38. ________ sheep hair and wolf hair.
The brush handle is usually made of bamboo, wood or even jade (玉).
There are over a hundred steps to complete 39. ________ brush pen.
All the steps need to be done by hand.
The makers must be very patient and careful.
Thanks to these efforts, this traditional art is now full 40. ________ life again.
More and more young people are falling in love with it.
filled_text: The brush pen, one of the "Four Treasures of the Study", was invented thousands of years ago.
It is older than the other three treasures.
It was widely used in ancient China for writing and painting.
Even today, it plays an important role in Chinese culture.
With the rapid development of modern technology, however, fewer people use it in their daily life.
To pass down the tradition, many schools in China have offered calligraphy classes to students in the past few years.
Students are encouraged to practice Chinese calligraphy.
It is believed that calligraphy can not only improve students' writing skills, but also help them learn more about Chinese traditional culture and calm their minds down.
In this way, students can have a better understanding of the Chinese culture.
Besides, the government has also made great efforts to protect the skills of making brush pens.
Making a brush pen takes a lot of time and effort.
The brush part is usually made of animal hair, such as sheep hair and wolf hair.
The brush handle is usually made of bamboo, wood or even jade.
There are over a hundred steps to complete a brush pen.
All the steps need to be done by hand.
The makers must be very patient and careful.
Thanks to these efforts, this traditional art is now full of life again.
More and more young people are falling in love with it.
filled_text_cn: 毛笔，作为“文房四宝”之一，发明于数千年前。
它比其他三样宝物历史更悠久。
在古代中国，它被广泛用于书写和绘画。
即使在今天，它在中国文化中仍然扮演着重要角色。
然而，随着现代技术的飞速发展，日常生活中使用它的人越来越少了。
为了传承这一传统，过去几年来中国的许多学校都向学生提供了书法课程。
学生们被鼓励练习中国书法。
人们相信，书法不仅能提高学生的书写能力，还能帮助他们更多地了解中国传统文化，并平静心灵。
通过这种方式，学生们可以更好地理解中国文化。
此外，政府也做出了巨大努力来保护制作毛笔的技艺。
制作一支毛笔需要耗费大量的时间和心血。
毛刷部分通常由动物毛制成，比如羊毛和狼毫。
笔杆通常由竹子、木头甚至玉石制成。
制作完成一支毛笔需要一百多道工序。
所有的工序都需要手工完成。
制作匠人必须非常耐心和细致。
多亏了这些努力，这一传统艺术如今又重新充满了生机活力。
越来越多的年轻人正爱上它。

questions.grammar_point_name: 形容词比较级
questions.explanation: 句意：它比其他三宝历史更悠久。根据后文标志词'than'可知，此处需用形容词 old 的比较级 older。故填 older。
questions.rule_summary: 句中出现 than 时，形容词需使用比较级形式。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词时态与主谓一致（一般现在时第三人称单数）
questions.explanation: 句意：即使在今天，它在中国文化中仍然发挥着重要作用。根据'Even today'可知描述现在的情况，主语 it 是单数第三人称，谓语动词加 -s 用 plays。故填 plays。
questions.rule_summary: 时间状语 today 表当前常态，主语为第三人称单数时动词用三单形式。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词搭配 (in the past few years)
questions.explanation: 句意：在过去的几年里……in the past few years 为固定时间状语搭配，意为“在过去的几年中”，常与现在完成时连用。故填 in。
questions.rule_summary: in the past few years / in the last few years 意为“在过去的几年里”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：动词不定式 (be encouraged to do)
questions.explanation: 句意：学生们被鼓励练习中国书法。encourage sb. to do sth. 的被动结构为 be encouraged to do sth.，用不定式 to practice。故填 to practice。
questions.rule_summary: be encouraged to do sth. 意为“被鼓励做某事”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 并列连词关联搭配 (not only ... but also)
questions.explanation: 句意：不仅能提高学生的书写技巧，而且还能帮助他们了解传统文化。固定连词搭配 not only ... but also ...，意为“不仅……而且……”。故填 but。
questions.rule_summary: not only ... but also ... 为常用并列连词搭配，连接两个对称结构。

questions.grammar_point_name: 形容词比较级 (a better understanding)
questions.explanation: 句意：通过这种方式，学生们可以对中国文化有更好的理解。have a better understanding of ... 是固定短语，表示“对……有更深入/更好的理解”，well 作形容词时比较级为 better。故填 better。
questions.rule_summary: 短语 have a better understanding of ... 意为“更好地理解……”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：介词后接动名词
questions.explanation: 句意：保护制作毛笔的技艺。介词 of 后面必须接动名词作宾语，make 的动名词形式去 e 加 -ing 为 making。故填 making。
questions.rule_summary: 介词（如 of, in, for, about 等）之后接动词时，必须用动名词 -ing 形式。

questions.grammar_point_name: 固定列举介词短语 (such as)
questions.explanation: 句意：比如羊毛和狼毫。such as 为固定搭配，用于列举同类事物，意为“例如，诸如”。故填 as。
questions.rule_summary: such as 用于列举同类人或事物，意为“例如”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 不定冠词 (a)
questions.explanation: 句意：完成一支毛笔需要一百多道工序。此处泛指“一支毛笔”，brush 以辅音音素开头，用不定冠词 a。故填 a。
questions.rule_summary: 单数可数名词前表泛指一类或“一个”时，用不定冠词 a/an。

questions.grammar_point_name: 形容词介词搭配 (full of)
questions.explanation: 句意：这项传统艺术如今又重新充满了活力。be full of ... 为固定搭配，意为“充满……”。故填 of。
questions.rule_summary: be full of ... 意为“充满……”，相当于 be filled with ...。

sections.title: Passage E - Teenage Sprinter Chen Yujie (短跑少女陈妤颉)
raw_text: Chen Yujie, a 15-year-old girl, is having training at Ningbo Sports School.
She ran 41. ________ (fast) than any other Asian woman under 20 in 2024.
She finished the 100 meters in 11.29 seconds at a national competition in Chongqing on June 29, 42. ________ (break) the Asian youth record of 11.42 seconds.
Chen was born into a sports family.
Her parents were both sprinters (短跑运动员).
She grew up on the sports ground and showed great talent in running 43. ________ an early age.
Her parents didn't want 44. ________ (she) to be a professional athlete at first because they knew how hard it was.
However, Chen showed a strong love 45. ________ running.
She said running gave her a sense of freedom.
Finally, her parents agreed to support her.
Chen started serious training in 2019.
She practiced very hard every day, even in hot summer 46. ________ cold winter.
She never gave up when she faced 47. ________ (difficulty).
Her hard work has paid off.
In 2023, she won two gold 48. ________ (medal) at the East Asian Youth Games.
Her coach praised her, "Chen is a gifted runner, but what makes her special is her hard work and strong will."
Now, Chen has a bigger dream.
She hopes to compete in the Olympics one day and win glory for China.
"I know there is still a long way 49. ________ (go), but I will keep running towards my dream," Chen said 50. ________ (confident).
filled_text: Chen Yujie, a 15-year-old girl, is having training at Ningbo Sports School.
She ran faster than any other Asian woman under 20 in 2024.
She finished the 100 meters in 11.29 seconds at a national competition in Chongqing on June 29, breaking the Asian youth record of 11.42 seconds.
Chen was born into a sports family.
Her parents were both sprinters.
She grew up on the sports ground and showed great talent in running at an early age.
Her parents didn't want her to be a professional athlete at first because they knew how hard it was.
However, Chen showed a strong love for running.
She said running gave her a sense of freedom.
Finally, her parents agreed to support her.
Chen started serious training in 2019.
She practiced very hard every day, even in hot summer or cold winter.
She never gave up when she faced difficulties.
Her hard work has paid off.
In 2023, she won two gold medals at the East Asian Youth Games.
Her coach praised her, "Chen is a gifted runner, but what makes her special is her hard work and strong will."
Now, Chen has a bigger dream.
She hopes to compete in the Olympics one day and win glory for China.
"I know there is still a long way to go, but I will keep running towards my dream," Chen said confidently.
filled_text_cn: 15岁的女孩陈妤颉正在宁波体校接受训练。
在2024年，她跑得比任何其他20岁以下的亚洲女性都要快。
6月29日在重庆举行的全国比赛中，她以11.29秒的成绩跑完100米，打破了11.42秒的亚洲青年纪录。
陈妤颉出生在一个体育世家。
她的父母都是短跑运动员。
她在运动场上长大，在很小的时候就展现出了极高的跑步天赋。
她的父母起初并不想让她成为一名专业运动员，因为他们知道这有多么辛苦。
然而，陈妤颉表现出了对跑步的强烈热爱。
她说跑步给了她一种自由的感觉。
最终，她的父母同意支持她。
陈妤颉于2019年开始接受正规训练。
她每天都非常刻苦地训练，哪怕是在炎炎夏日或寒冷冬日。
面对困难时，她从未放弃过。
她的辛勤付出得到了回报。
2023年，她在东亚青年运动会上赢得了两枚金牌。
她的教练称赞她说：“陈妤颉是一个有天赋的跑者，但真正让她与众不同的是她的勤奋和顽强的意志。”
现在，陈妤颉有了更大的梦想。
她希望有一天能参加奥运会，为中国赢得荣誉。
“我知道还有很长的路要走，但我会继续朝着我的梦想奔跑，”陈妤颉自信地说。

questions.grammar_point_name: 副词比较级
questions.explanation: 句意：她在2024年比任何其他20岁以下的亚洲女性跑得都更快。句中有比较标志词 than，修饰动词 ran 用副词比较级 faster。故填 faster。
questions.rule_summary: 后有 than 比较对象时，副词 fast 应用比较级 faster。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：现在分词作结果状语
questions.explanation: 句意：打破了11.42秒的亚洲青年纪录。此处用现在分词 breaking 作自然产生的结果状语。故填 breaking。
questions.rule_summary: 现在分词 -ing 作结果状语，表示主句动作必然或顺理成章带来的结果。

questions.grammar_point_name: 固定介词搭配 (at an early age)
questions.explanation: 句意：在很小的时候就展现出了跑步的天赋。at an early age 为固定短语，意为“在幼年，在很小的时候”。故填 at。
questions.rule_summary: at an early age 意为“在幼年，早年”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 人称代词主格变宾格
questions.explanation: 句意：起初她的父母不想让她成为专业运动员。want sb. to do sth.，动词后接人称代词作宾语，用宾格 her。故填 her。
questions.rule_summary: 及物动词 want 的宾语代词应用宾格 her。

questions.grammar_point_name: 名词介词搭配 (love for)
questions.explanation: 句意：然而陈妤颉表现出了对跑步的强烈热爱。love for sth. 表示“对……的热爱”。故填 for。
questions.rule_summary: a love for sth. 意为“对某事物的热爱”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 并列连词 (or)
questions.explanation: 句意：哪怕是在酷暑或严冬。连接两个对立的天气季节，表选择并列关系，用连词 or。故填 or。
questions.rule_summary: hot summer or cold winter 表示“无论夏日还是冬日”，用 or 连接两种极端选择。

questions.grammar_point_name: 可数名词变复数 (y变ies)
questions.explanation: 句意：当面对各种困难时，她从未放弃。difficulty 表示具体遇到的“难题，困境”时为可数名词，face difficulties 为常见复数表达，辅音+y变 ies。故填 difficulties。
questions.rule_summary: difficulty 表示各种具体的困难时为可数名词，变复数将 y 变为 ies。

questions.grammar_point_name: 可数名词复数形式
questions.explanation: 句意：她赢得了两枚金牌。基数词 two 后接可数名词复数 medals。故填 medals。
questions.rule_summary: 大于1的基数词后修饰可数名词，名词必须用复数形式。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：不定式作后置定语 (a long way to go)
questions.explanation: 句意：我知道还有很长的路要走。a long way to go 为常用固定表达，不定式 to go 作后置定语修饰 way。故填 to go。
questions.rule_summary: a long way to go 意为“还有很长的路要走”，to do 作后置定语。

questions.grammar_point_name: 形容词变副词 (修饰说动词 said)
questions.explanation: 句意：陈妤颉自信地说。修饰动词 said，应用形容词 confident 对应的副词 confidently 作状语。故填 confidently。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰说话动词 say / said 等，用副词修饰表达态度和语气。

sections.title: Passage F - Virtue and Ability in Zizhi Tongjian (才与德)
raw_text: There is a story in the book *History as a Mirror* (《资治通鉴》) by the Chinese historian Sima Guang.
It talks about a family meeting held by Zhi Xuanzi, the leader of the Zhi family, to choose a new family leader.
Zhi Xuanzi wanted to choose Zhi Yao, 51. ________ he was strong, handsome, good at shooting and riding, and brave.
However, Zhi Guo, 52. ________ member of the family, disagreed.
He said, "Zhi Yao has all these advantages, but he has one big weakness: he lacks 53. ________ (kind).
If he 54. ________ (become) the leader, he will bring trouble to our family."
Unfortunately, Zhi Xuanzi didn't listen to Zhi Guo's advice and made Zhi Yao the leader.
Later, Zhi Yao became greedy and arrogant (傲慢的).
He asked for land from other families.
Finally, the other families united and defeated Zhi Yao.
The Zhi family was completely destroyed.

In his book, Sima Guang divides people into four types according to their virtue (德) and ability (才): sages (圣人) have both virtue and ability; fools (愚人) have neither; gentlemen (君子) have more virtue than ability; villains (小人) have more ability than virtue.
Sima Guang thought that a person's virtue is far more important than 55. ________ (he) ability.
He advised rulers 56. ________ (choose) people with both virtue and ability.
If they cannot find sages, they should choose gentlemen rather than villains.
57. ________ a villain has great ability, he will use it to do bad things, which can cause great harm to the country.
This story tells 58. ________ (we) that in our daily life, we should pay more attention to our character and moral qualities.
Having high abilities is important, but being a person 59. ________ good virtue is even more fundamental.
Only when we have good morals 60. ________ (can) we use our talents to serve society properly.
filled_text: There is a story in the book History as a Mirror by the Chinese historian Sima Guang.
It talks about a family meeting held by Zhi Xuanzi, the leader of the Zhi family, to choose a new family leader.
Zhi Xuanzi wanted to choose Zhi Yao, because he was strong, handsome, good at shooting and riding, and brave.
However, Zhi Guo, another member of the family, disagreed.
He said, "Zhi Yao has all these advantages, but he has one big weakness: he lacks kindness.
If he becomes the leader, he will bring trouble to our family."
Unfortunately, Zhi Xuanzi didn't listen to Zhi Guo's advice and made Zhi Yao the leader.
Later, Zhi Yao became greedy and arrogant.
He asked for land from other families.
Finally, the other families united and defeated Zhi Yao.
The Zhi family was completely destroyed.

In his book, Sima Guang divides people into four types according to their virtue and ability: sages have both virtue and ability; fools have neither; gentlemen have more virtue than ability; villains have more ability than virtue.
Sima Guang thought that a person's virtue is far more important than his ability.
He advised rulers to choose people with both virtue and ability.
If they cannot find sages, they should choose gentlemen rather than villains.
If a villain has great ability, he will use it to do bad things, which can cause great harm to the country.
This story tells us that in our daily life, we should pay more attention to our character and moral qualities.
Having high abilities is important, but being a person of good virtue is even more fundamental.
Only when we have good morals can we use our talents to serve society properly.
filled_text_cn: 在中国历史学家司马光所著的《资治通鉴》中有一个故事。
它讲述了智家族长智宣子为选出新的家族领袖而召开的一次家族会议。
智宣子想选择智瑶，因为他身体强壮、英俊潇洒、善于骑射且勇敢勇猛。
然而，该家族的另一位成员智果表示反对。
他说：“智瑶拥有所有这些优点，但他有一个致命的弱点：他缺乏仁德。
如果他成为领袖，他会给我们的家族带来灾难。”
遗憾的是，智宣子没有听取智果的建议，依然立智瑶为领袖。
后来，智瑶变得贪婪傲慢。
他向其他家族索要土地。
最终，其他家族联合起来打败了智瑶。
智家遭到了彻底毁灭。
司马光在书中根据德行和才能将人分为四类：德才兼备者为“圣人”；德才俱亡者为“愚人”；德胜才者为“君子”；才胜德者为“小人”。
司马光认为，一个人的品德远比他的才能更重要。
他建议统治者任用德才兼备的人。
如果找不到圣人，他们应该任用君子，而不是任用小人。
如果一个小人拥有强大的才能，他就会用它来做坏事，这会对国家造成巨大的危害。
这个故事告诉我们，在日常生活中，我们应该更加注重自己的品格和道德品质。
具备高超的才能固然重要，但做一个品德高尚的人更是立身之本。
只有当我们拥有良好的道德操守时，我们才能正确地利用我们的才能为社会服务。

questions.grammar_point_name: 原因状语从句连词 (because)
questions.explanation: 句意：智宣子想选智瑶，因为他身材强壮、英俊帅气、擅长骑射……后半句是选智瑶的原因，用原因状语从句从属连词 because。故填 because。
questions.rule_summary: 引导解释前文动作原因的句子时，用从属连词 because。

questions.grammar_point_name: 不定代词 (another)
questions.explanation: 句意：然而家族的另一位成员智果表示反对。member 为单数名词，表示泛指三者或三者以上中的“另一个”，用 another。故填 another。
questions.rule_summary: another + 单数可数名词，表示“另外一个，又一个”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 形容词派生名词 (kind -> kindness)
questions.explanation: 句意：他缺乏仁德/善良。动词 lacks 后接不可数名词作宾语，形容词 kind 对应的名词形式是 kindness。故填 kindness。
questions.rule_summary: 形容词 kind 加后缀 -ness 派生为抽象名词 kindness，意为“仁慈，善意”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 条件状语从句主将从现
questions.explanation: 句意：如果他成为领袖，他会给家族带来麻烦。if 引导的真实条件状语从句遵循“主将从现”原则，主句用 will bring，从句用一般现在时，主语 he 为第三人称单数，动词变 becomes。故填 becomes。
questions.rule_summary: if 引导的条件状语从句中，主句使用一般将来时，从句使用一般现在时表将来（主将从现）。

questions.grammar_point_name: 形容词性物主代词
questions.explanation: 句意：一个人的品德远比他的才能更重要。修饰名词 ability，应用形容词性物主代词 his。故填 his。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰名词时，人称代词需变为形容词性物主代词 his。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：动词短语搭配 (advise sb. to do)
questions.explanation: 句意：他建议统治者选择德才兼备之人。advise sb. to do sth. 为固定搭配，意为“建议某人做某事”，用不定式 to choose。故填 to choose。
questions.rule_summary: advise sb. to do sth. 意为“建议某人做某事”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 条件状语从句连词 (If)
questions.explanation: 句意：如果一个小人有大本事，他会用它来做坏事。引导假设条件状语从句，意为“如果”，首字母大写用 If。故填 If。
questions.rule_summary: If 引导条件状语从句，表示“假使，如果”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 人称代词主格变宾格
questions.explanation: 句意：这个故事告诉我们……tell sb. sth.，动词后接人称代词作间接宾语，we 变为宾格 us。故填 us。
questions.rule_summary: 及物动词后接代词作宾语时，必须使用宾格形式 us。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词短语作后置定语 (of + 抽象名词)
questions.explanation: 句意：但做一个品德高尚的人更为根本。“a person of good virtue”中，“of + 抽象名词”作后置定语，表示“具有某种品质的”。故填 of。
questions.rule_summary: “of + 名词”结构可充当后置定语，表示某人的特征、品质（如 a man of virtue 品德高尚的人）。

questions.grammar_point_name: Only+状语置于句首的部分倒装
questions.explanation: 句意：只有当我们拥有良好品德时，我们才能恰当地利用我们的才干服务社会。“Only + 状语从句”置于句首，主句需用部分倒装语序，将情态动词 can 提前至主语 we 之前。故填 can。
questions.rule_summary: “Only + 状语”置于句首时，主句采用部分倒装（助动词/情态动词置于主语之前）。

sections.title: Passage G - The Magic of Decluttering (断舍离与整理)
raw_text: Have you ever run around looking for your shoes when you should already be on your way to school?
Or have you ever felt stressed out when your room 61. ________ (fill) with too many things?
If so, it's time for you to learn the art of tidying up and decluttering (整理与断舍离).
Many teenagers have the habit of keeping old things, such as broken toys, old notebooks and clothes they no longer wear.
They think they might need 62. ________ (they) in the future.
However, keeping too much clutter not only takes up space, 63. ________ also makes your mind feel messy.
A messy room often leads to a messy mind.
How can we start decluttering?
First, choose one area at a time, such as your study desk or wardrobe (衣柜).
Take everything out and divide them 64. ________ three groups: keep, donate, and throw away.
Second, ask 65. ________ (you) whether you really need or love each item.
If you haven't used an item for over 66. ________ year, you probably don't need it anymore.
Third, put the things you decide to keep back in order.
Give each item a fixed home so that you can find it 67. ________ (easy) next time.
Decluttering is not just about cleaning up your room; it is also a way of 68. ________ (clear) your thoughts.
After tidying up, you will find 69. ________ much easier to focus on your studies.
Start today, and you will enjoy a much 70. ________ (comfortable) and more relaxing life!
filled_text: Have you ever run around looking for your shoes when you should already be on your way to school?
Or have you ever felt stressed out when your room is filled with too many things?
If so, it's time for you to learn the art of tidying up and decluttering.
Many teenagers have the habit of keeping old things, such as broken toys, old notebooks and clothes they no longer wear.
They think they might need them in the future.
However, keeping too much clutter not only takes up space, but also makes your mind feel messy.
A messy room often leads to a messy mind.
How can we start decluttering?
First, choose one area at a time, such as your study desk or wardrobe.
Take everything out and divide them into three groups: keep, donate, and throw away.
Second, ask yourself whether you really need or love each item.
If you haven't used an item for over a year, you probably don't need it anymore.
Third, put the things you decide to keep back in order.
Give each item a fixed home so that you can find it easily next time.
Decluttering is not just about cleaning up your room; it is also a way of clearing your thoughts.
After tidying up, you will find it much easier to focus on your studies.
Start today, and you will enjoy a much more comfortable and more relaxing life!
filled_text_cn: 你是否曾因为找鞋子而四处乱跑，而此时你本该已经在去上学的路上了？
或者当你的房间塞满了太多东西时，你是否曾感到压力重重？
如果是这样，那么该是你学习整理和断舍离艺术的时候了。
许多青少年都有保留旧物的习惯，比如坏掉的玩具、旧笔记本以及不再穿的衣服。
他们认为将来可能会需要它们。
然而，保留太多杂物不仅占用空间，还会让你的心情感到混乱烦躁。
凌乱的房间往往会导致混乱的心情。
我们该如何开始断舍离呢？
首先，一次选择一个区域，比如你的书桌或衣柜。
把所有东西拿出来，分成三组：保留、捐赠和扔掉。
第二，问问你自己是否真的需要或喜爱每一件物品。
如果你有一年多没用过某件物品，你可能再也不需要它了。
第三，把你决定保留的东西按顺序放回原位。
给每件物品一个固定的“家”，这样下次你就能轻松找到它。
断舍离不仅仅是清理房间，它也是理清思绪的一种方式。
整理之后，你会发现专心学习变得容易得多。
从今天开始吧，你将享受更舒适、更轻松的生活！

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态 (be filled with)
questions.explanation: 句意：当你的房间装满了太多东西时。be filled with ... 为固定被动短语搭配，此处讲述现阶段普遍现象，主语 your room 为单数，用一般现在时 is filled。故填 is filled。
questions.rule_summary: be filled with ... 意为“装满……，充满……”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 人称代词主格变宾格
questions.explanation: 句意：他们认为将来可能会需要它们。动词 need 后接人称代词作宾语，代指前文的 old things，用宾格 them。故填 them。
questions.rule_summary: 及物动词 need 后接人称代词作宾语时，使用宾格 them。

questions.grammar_point_name: 并列连词关联搭配 (not only ... but also)
questions.explanation: 句意：不仅占据空间，而且还会让你的思绪感到混乱。固定搭配 not only ... but also ...，意为“不仅……而且……”。故填 but。
questions.rule_summary: not only ... but also ... 为常见并列连词短语，此处缺少 but。

questions.grammar_point_name: 动词介词搭配 (divide ... into)
questions.explanation: 句意：把它们分成三组。divide ... into ... 为固定搭配，意为“把……分成……”。故填 into。
questions.rule_summary: divide ... into ... 意为“把……分成……”，into 表划分成的结果。

questions.grammar_point_name: 反身代词 (yourself)
questions.explanation: 句意：问问你自己是否真的需要或喜爱每样物品。祈使句主语省略了 you，动作施加给主语自身时，使用反身代词 yourself。故填 yourself。
questions.rule_summary: 主语发出动作施加于自身时，宾语使用反身代词形式 yourself / yourselves。

questions.grammar_point_name: 不定冠词 (a)
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你有一年多没用过某件物品。over a year 意为“超过一年”，year 读音以辅音音素 /j/ 开头，用不定冠词 a。故填 a。
questions.rule_summary: year 读音以半元音 /j/（属辅音音素）开头，前面用不定冠词 a。

questions.grammar_point_name: 形容词变副词 (辅音+y变ily)
questions.explanation: 句意：这样下次你就可以轻松找到它。修饰动词短语 find it，需用副词 easily 作状语，辅音+y变 ily。故填 easily。
questions.rule_summary: easy 以辅音字母 + y 结尾，变为副词时变 y 为 i 再加 -ly 为 easily。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：介词后接动名词
questions.explanation: 句意：它也是一种理清思绪的方式。介词 of 后面接动名词作宾语，用 clearing。故填 clearing。
questions.rule_summary: 介词 of 后面接动词时，必须使用动名词 -ing 形式。

questions.grammar_point_name: 形式宾语 (it)
questions.explanation: 句意：你会发现专心学习容易得多。find it + adj. + to do sth. 为固定句型，it 在句中作形式宾语，真正的宾语是不定式短语 to focus on your studies。故填 it。
questions.rule_summary: find / make / feel it + adj. + to do sth. 句型中，it 作形式宾语代替后面的不定式。

questions.grammar_point_name: 形容词比较级 (much + 比较级)
questions.explanation: 句意：你将享受一个舒适得多、轻松得多的生活！与后文 more relaxing 并列，且前面有程度副词 much 修饰比较级，多音节形容词 comfortable 的比较级为 more comfortable。故填 more comfortable。
questions.rule_summary: 多音节形容词的比较级在前加 more；much 可用来修饰形容词比较级加强语气。

sections.title: Passage H - Environmental Pollution (环境污染)
raw_text: This week, our topic is pollution.
We asked 71. ________ (second) experts to share their opinions on this serious problem.
Professor Green pointed out that air pollution is 72. ________ (bad) than ever in many big cities.
"Cars and factories produce too much dirty smoke every day, 73. ________ causes smog and respiratory (呼吸系统的) diseases," he explained.
He suggested that people 74. ________ (take) public transport instead of driving private cars.
Dr. White, an expert on water resources, showed deep concern about water pollution.
She said that industrial waste and plastic rubbish 75. ________ (pollute) rivers and oceans across the world for decades.
"Millions of sea creatures die 76. ________ plastic waste every year," she warned.
She called 77. ________ stricter laws to stop factories from pouring dirty water directly into rivers.
Both experts agreed that pollution can not be solved overnight.
It requires the joint efforts of governments, enterprises and every single 78. ________ (citizen).
As teenagers, we can do our part by 79. ________ (save) water, sorting rubbish, and saying no to single-use plastics.
Only when everyone takes action 80. ________ our planet become greener and healthier.
filled_text: This week, our topic is pollution.
We asked two experts to share their opinions on this serious problem.
Professor Green pointed out that air pollution is worse than ever in many big cities.
"Cars and factories produce too much dirty smoke every day, which causes smog and respiratory diseases," he explained.
He suggested that people take public transport instead of driving private cars.
Dr. White, an expert on water resources, showed deep concern about water pollution.
She said that industrial waste and plastic rubbish have polluted rivers and oceans across the world for decades.
"Millions of sea creatures die from plastic waste every year," she warned.
She called for stricter laws to stop factories from pouring dirty water directly into rivers.
Both experts agreed that pollution can not be solved overnight.
It requires the joint efforts of governments, enterprises and every single citizen.
As teenagers, we can do our part by saving water, sorting rubbish, and saying no to single-use plastics.
Only when everyone takes action will our planet become greener and healthier.
filled_text_cn: 本周，我们的主题是污染。
我们邀请了两位专家就这一严重问题分享他们的看法。
格林教授指出，在许多大城市中，空气污染比以往任何时候都更加严重。
“汽车和工厂每天产生太多的污浊烟尘，这导致了雾霾和呼吸系统疾病，”他解释道。
他建议人们乘坐公共交通工具，而不是开私家车。
水资源专家怀特博士对水污染表达了深深的担忧。
她说，几十年来，工业废物和塑料垃圾已经污染了世界各地的河流和海洋。
“每年有数以百万计的海洋生物死于塑料垃圾，”她警告道。
她呼吁制定更严格的法律，以阻止工厂将污水直接排入河流。
两位专家都认为，污染问题不可能一夜之间解决。
它需要政府、企业和每一个公民的共同努力。
作为青少年，我们可以通过节约用水、垃圾分类以及对一次性塑料说“不”来尽自己的一份力。
只有当每个人都采取行动时，我们的地球才会变得更绿、更健康。

questions.grammar_point_name: 序数词变基数词
questions.explanation: 句意：我们邀请了两位专家就这一严重问题分享他们的看法。根据后文复数名词 experts 以及后文提到的格林教授和怀特博士可知共有两个人，序数词 second 需转换为基数词 two。故填 two。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰复数名词表数量时，序数词需还原为对应的基数词（如 second -> two）。

questions.grammar_point_name: 形容词不规则比较级 (bad -> worse)
questions.explanation: 句意：许多大城市的空气污染比以往任何时候都更糟糕。后有比较标志词 than，形容词 bad 的不规则比较级为 worse。故填 worse。
questions.rule_summary: bad 的比较级为不规则变化形式 worse，最高级为 worst。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非限制性定语从句关系代词 (which指代整句话)
questions.explanation: 句意：产生太多脏烟尘，这导致了雾霾……逗号后为非限制性定语从句，指代前面整句话的内容，在从句中作主语，只能用 which。故填 which。
questions.rule_summary: 在非限制性定语从句中指代前面整个主句的内容时，关系代词只能用 which。

questions.grammar_point_name: 虚拟语气：suggest从句接(should) do
questions.explanation: 句意：他建议人们乘坐公共交通。suggest 表示“建议”时，宾语从句谓语动词使用虚拟语气“(should) + 动词原形”，should 常省略，故填 take。故填 take。
questions.rule_summary: suggest 后接 that 宾语从句时，从句谓语用“(should) + 动词原形”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词时态（现在完成时）
questions.explanation: 句意：几十年来已经污染了世界各地的河流和海洋。时间状语为 for decades（数十年来），强调动作持续至今并带来严重后果，主语为复数概念，用现在完成时 have polluted。故填 have polluted。
questions.rule_summary: “for + 一段时间”作时间状语，谓语动词通常使用现在完成时 have/has + done。

questions.grammar_point_name: 动词介词搭配 (die from)
questions.explanation: 句意：每年有数百万海洋生物死于塑料垃圾。die from 表示“死于（外在原因，如事故、环境污染等）”，此处塑料垃圾属于外部污染致死原因。故填 from。
questions.rule_summary: die from 多指死于外因、事故或环境创伤，die of 多指死于疾病、饥饿或内在衰竭。

questions.grammar_point_name: 动词介词搭配 (call for)
questions.explanation: 句意：她呼吁制定更严格的法律。call for 为常用动词短语，意为“呼吁，要求”。故填 for。
questions.rule_summary: call for 意为“呼吁，需要，要求”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 可数名词单数 (every single + 单数名词)
questions.explanation: 句意：需要政府、企业和每一个公民的共同努力。every single 后接单数可数名词，citizen 表示“公民”。故填 citizen。
questions.rule_summary: every single 修饰单数可数名词，强调“每一个单独的个体”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：介词后接动名词
questions.explanation: 句意：我们可以通过节约用水……尽一份力。介词 by 后接动名词形式作宾语，并与后文 sorting, saying 保持并列，save 的动名词形式为 saving。故填 saving。
questions.rule_summary: 介词 by 后面接动名词短语，表示通过某种方式或手段。

questions.grammar_point_name: Only+状语从句置于句首的部分倒装 (助动词will)
questions.explanation: 句意：只有当每个人都采取行动时，我们的地球才会变得更绿。Only when ... 状语从句置于句首，主句需部分倒装，后半句描述未来结果，将助动词 will 提前至主语 our planet 之前。故填 will。
questions.rule_summary: Only when 引导的时间状语从句置于句首时，主句采用部分倒装，将来时提前助动词 will。

sections.title: Passage I - National Hero Yue Fei (民族英雄岳飞)
raw_text: Most Chinese people know and look up Yue Fei.
He is 81. ________ hero from the Southern Song Dynasty.
Yue Fei was born in 82. ________ poor farmer's family in Tangyin, Henan.
When he was young, he worked hard and learned martial arts (武术).
He was known for 83. ________ (he) shooting skills.
He could shoot accurately with both hands.
When northern invaders attacked the Song Dynasty, Yue Fei joined the army 84. ________ (defend) his country.
Before he left home, his mother tattooed (刺字) four Chinese characters on his back: Jin Zhong Bao Guo, 85. ________ means "serving the country with total loyalty".
Yue Fei kept these words in mind throughout his life.
In the army, Yue Fei showed great military talent.
He formed the famous Yue Army, which was known for its strict discipline.
There was a saying about them: "It is easier to move a mountain than 86. ________ (shake) the Yue Army."
Under his leadership, the army won many battles against the invaders and recovered a large area of lost 87. ________ (land).
88. ________ (sad), the emperor and some corrupt officials wanted to make peace with the enemies.
They ordered Yue Fei to stop fighting and return to the capital.
Yue Fei 89. ________ (put) in prison and killed falsely at the age of 39.
Yue Fei's spirit of patriotism has inspired generations of Chinese people.
His famous poem *Man Jiang Hong* is still 90. ________ (wide) recited today.
filled_text: Most Chinese people know and look up Yue Fei.
He is a hero from the Southern Song Dynasty.
Yue Fei was born in a poor farmer's family in Tangyin, Henan.
When he was young, he worked hard and learned martial arts.
He was known for his shooting skills.
He could shoot accurately with both hands.
When northern invaders attacked the Song Dynasty, Yue Fei joined the army to defend his country.
Before he left home, his mother tattooed four Chinese characters on his back: Jin Zhong Bao Guo, which means "serving the country with total loyalty".
Yue Fei kept these words in mind throughout his life.
In the army, Yue Fei showed great military talent.
He formed the famous Yue Army, which was known for its strict discipline.
There was a saying about them: "It is easier to move a mountain than to shake the Yue Army."
Under his leadership, the army won many battles against the invaders and recovered a large area of lost land.
Sadly, the emperor and some corrupt officials wanted to make peace with the enemies.
They ordered Yue Fei to stop fighting and return to the capital.
Yue Fei was put in prison and killed falsely at the age of 39.
Yue Fei's spirit of patriotism has inspired generations of Chinese people.
His famous poem Man Jiang Hong is still widely recited today.
filled_text_cn: 大多数中国人都熟知并敬仰岳飞。
他是南宋时期的一位英雄。
岳飞出生在河南汤阴的一个贫苦农家。
年轻时，他刻苦勤勉，习练武艺。
他以精湛的射箭技艺而闻名。
他能够左右开弓、精准射击。
当北方侵略者进犯宋朝时，岳飞参军保家卫国。
在他离家之前，他的母亲在他背上刺了四个汉字：“精忠报国”，意为“竭尽忠诚报效国家”。
岳飞终生铭记这几个字。
在军中，岳飞展现出了非凡的军事才能。
他组建了著名的“岳家军”，以纪律严明著称于世。
当时有句流传的谚语评价他们：“撼山易，撼岳家军难。”
在他的率领下，这支军队在抗击侵略者的战斗中屡屡获胜，收复了大片失地。
可悲的是，皇帝和一些奸臣想要与敌人议和。
他们命令岳飞停止战斗并返回京城。
岳飞被关进监狱，年仅39岁时含冤遇害。
岳飞的爱国精神激励了一代又一代的中国人民。
他的著名诗词《满江红》至今仍被广泛传诵。

questions.grammar_point_name: 不定冠词 (a)
questions.explanation: 句意：他是南宋时期的一位英雄。hero 为单数可数名词，此处泛指“一位英雄”，hero 以辅音音素开头，用不定冠词 a。故填 a。
questions.rule_summary: 单数可数名词表示泛指某类人之一时，以辅音音素开头用不定冠词 a。

questions.grammar_point_name: 不定冠词 (a)
questions.explanation: 句意：岳飞出生在一个贫苦的农民家庭。in a ... family 为固定结构，表示“出生在一个……的家庭”，poor 以辅音音素开头，用不定冠词 a。故填 a。
questions.rule_summary: be born in a ... family 意为“出生在一个……的家庭”，用不定冠词 a。

questions.grammar_point_name: 形容词性物主代词
questions.explanation: 句意：他以他的射箭技艺闻名。修饰名词短语 shooting skills，需用形容词性物主代词 his。故填 his。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰名词作定语时，人称代词用形容词性物主代词 his。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：不定式作目的状语
questions.explanation: 句意：岳飞参军以保卫他的国家。此处用动词不定式 to defend 作目的状语，表示参军的目的。故填 to defend。
questions.rule_summary: 动词不定式 to do 常在句中充当目的状语，表示“为了……”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非限制性定语从句关系代词 (which)
questions.explanation: 句意：精忠报国，意思是“以全身心的忠诚报效国家”。逗号后为非限制性定语从句，先行词是 Jin Zhong Bao Guo，从句中缺少主语，只能用 which。故填 which。
questions.rule_summary: 非限制性定语从句先行词为物且在从句中作主语时，关系词只能用 which。

questions.grammar_point_name: 非谓语动词：than后不定式对称结构
questions.explanation: 句意：“撼山易，撼岳家军难。”句型 It is easier to do sth. than to do sth.，than 前后不定式结构保持对称，用 to shake。故填 to shake。
questions.rule_summary: 比较级结构中的 than 前后连接相同形式的非谓语动词（to do ... than to do ...）保持对称。

questions.grammar_point_name: 不可数名词用法
questions.explanation: 句意：收复了大片失地。land 表示“国土，领土”时为不可数名词，a large area of land 意为“大片土地/国土”，保持原形 land。故填 land。
questions.rule_summary: land 表“国土，土地”概念时常作不可数名词，接在 a large area of 之后用原形。

questions.grammar_point_name: 形容词变副词作评注性状语 (Sadly)
questions.explanation: 句意：令人悲伤的是/可悲的是，皇帝和一些奸臣想要议和。位于句首用逗号隔开，修饰整个句子作评注性状语，用副词 sadly，首字母大写。故填 Sadly。
questions.rule_summary: 副词置于句首修饰全句，作评注性状语（如 Sadly, Luckily, Fortunately 等）。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（一般过去时的被动语态）
questions.explanation: 句意：岳飞被关进监狱。主语 Yue Fei 与 put 之间是被动关系，且与后文 was killed 并列，为一般过去时的被动语态 was put。故填 was put。
questions.rule_summary: 主语为单数且动作发生在过去，被动语态结构为 was + 过去分词（put过去分词为put）。

questions.grammar_point_name: 形容词变副词 (修饰动词 recited)
questions.explanation: 句意：他的著名诗词《满江红》至今仍被广泛背诵。修饰过去分词 recited，应用副词 widely 表示“广泛地”。故填 widely。
questions.rule_summary: 副词 widely 意为“广泛地”，常用于修饰 read, known, recited 等动词分词。

sections.title: Passage J - Peter's Holiday Trip to Shanghai (彼得的上海游)

filled_text_cn: 彼得是一名八年级学生，住在苏州。
清明假期期间，彼得一家通常会去附近的城市旅游，比如南京和杭州。
但彼得一直希望能去上海游览。
今年，他的梦想终于成真了。
4月4日，彼得一家坐火车前往上海。
在酒店稍作休息后，他们步行前往地铁站。
他们的第一个目的地是青浦区的朱家角古镇。
他们乘坐地铁是因为它要快得多。
古镇里有各种各样的活动。
到达那里后，他们首先品尝了许多美味的特色小吃。
然后他们观看了昆曲表演和汉服秀。
他们还参加了夜航游船，欣赏了花灯。
第二天，彼得一家去了海昌海洋公园。
他们不仅观赏了许多海洋动物，还参加了一些与节日相关的传统活动。
例如，彼得玩了一种古代游戏——投壶。
这是他第一次尝试这种游戏。
它非常有趣。
在嘉定区的安亭大融城，假期期间举办了四场音乐会。
音乐家们演奏了中西方乐器。
最后一天，彼得一家在音乐会上欣赏了老上海歌曲和国风音乐。
他们还去了嘉北郊野公园。
他们在音乐节上玩得很开心，并在汉字艺术展上拍了许多照片。
“这三天的假期对我来说是一次极棒的体验，”彼得说。
“我学到了许多关于中国传统艺术和历史的知识。”

questions.grammar_point_name: 动词固定搭配 (hope to do)
questions.explanation: 句意：但彼得一直希望能去上海游览。hope to do sth. 为固定搭配，意为“希望做某事”，接不定式 to visit。故填 to visit。
questions.rule_summary: hope 后面只能接动词不定式 to do 作宾语（hope to do sth.），不能接动名词。

questions.grammar_point_name: 具体日期的介词 (on)
questions.explanation: 句意：在4月4日，彼得一家坐火车前往上海。April 4th 是具体的某一天，时间介词用 on，置于句首首字母大写。故填 On。
questions.rule_summary: 在具体的某一月某一日前，使用介词 on。

questions.grammar_point_name: 形容词性物主代词 (Their)
questions.explanation: 句意：他们的第一个目的地是青浦区的朱家角古镇。修饰名词 destination，需用形容词性物主代词 their，句首大写为 Their。故填 Their。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰名词作定语时，代词 they 转换为形容词性物主代词 their。

questions.grammar_point_name: 形容词比较级 (much + 比较级)
questions.explanation: 句意：他们坐地铁是因为地铁要快得多。此处表示地铁比步行快得多，前面有程度副词 much 修饰，用形容词比较级 faster。故填 faster。
questions.rule_summary: much 可以修饰形容词比较级（much faster），表示“快得多”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词时态（一般过去时）
questions.explanation: 句意：到达那里后，他们首先品尝了许多美食。叙述过去旅行的动作，与后文 watched 并列，谓语动词用一般过去时 tasted。故填 tasted。
questions.rule_summary: 叙述过去的旅行活动经历，谓语动词用一般过去时。

questions.grammar_point_name: 可数名词变复数 (many + 复数)
questions.explanation: 句意：他们不仅观赏了许多海洋动物……many 修饰可数名词复数，animal 的复数形式为 animals。故填 animals。
questions.rule_summary: many 修饰可数名词复数形式。

questions.grammar_point_name: 动词派生形容词 (-ing形容物)
questions.explanation: 句意：它（投壶游戏）是如此有趣。主语 It 指代事物 the game，修饰物应用 -ing 结尾的形容词 interesting。故填 interesting。
questions.rule_summary: 形容物具有某种性质令人感到如何时，用 -ing 结尾形容词（如 interesting, exciting）。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（一般过去时的被动语态）
questions.explanation: 句意：假期期间举办了四场音乐会。主语 four music concerts 为复数，与 give 之间是被动关系，且发生在过去的假期，用一般过去时的被动语态 were given。故填 were given。
questions.rule_summary: 复数主语承受动作且动作发生在过去，被动语态用 were + 过去分词（given）。

questions.grammar_point_name: 并列连词 (and)
questions.explanation: 句意：他们在音乐节上玩得很开心，并在汉字艺术展上拍了许多照片。连接两个并列的谓语动词短语 had fun 和 took many photos，表示顺承并列关系，用连词 and。故填 and。
questions.rule_summary: 连接两个对称并列的过去式谓语动词短语，用并列连词 and。

questions.grammar_point_name: 不定冠词 (a)
questions.explanation: 句意：“这三天的假期对我来说是一次极棒的体验，”彼得说。experience 在此处表示具体的“一次经历/体验”，为单数可数名词，great 以辅音音素开头，用不定冠词 a。故填 a。
questions.rule_summary: experience 表示具体的“一段经历、一次体验”时为可数名词，泛指“一次”用 a great experience。

filled_text: I was born near New York city.
My parents weren't rich but there was always music in our home.
I remember when we were free, my mother used to play records by The Beatles and sing along with them.
By the time I was twelve years old, I had been supposed to know the words of hundreds of songs.
I often performed in front of my bedroom mirror and pretended that I was playing the guitar.
One day, my father came in, seeing me and laughing.
I felt so embarrassed that my face became red.
A few weeks later, my father came home with an electric guitar under his arm.
"It's for you, Tommy," he said.
"It's a special present for your 13th birthday.
I expect you can use this guitar to achieve your dream."
That was my first guitar.
At that moment, I felt I was the luckiest child in the world.
I practised very hard and spent hours almost every day practising playing the guitar.
After I graduated, I worked at a dance club.
I was writing lyrics for my songs then, but no one was paying any attention to them.
Things didn't go smoothly.
I didn't lose heart.
I stuck to singing songs.
I gave my tape to a famous musician.
He liked it and encouraged me.
Gradually, I became popular more and more people liked my songs.
filled_text_cn: 我出生在纽约市附近。
我的父母并不富裕，但在我们家里总是有音乐相伴。
我记得当我们有空闲时，我母亲过去常常播放甲壳虫乐队的唱片，并跟着一起唱。
到我十二岁的时候，大家就觉得我理应知道几百首歌的歌词了。
我经常在卧室的镜子前表演，假装自己在弹吉他。
有一天，我父亲走了进来，看到我并笑了起来。
我感到非常尴尬，脸都变红了。
几周后，我父亲胳膊下夹着一把电吉他回到家里。
“这是给你的，汤米，”他说。
“这是送给你13岁生日的特别礼物。
我期盼你能用这把吉他实现你的梦想。”
那是我的第一把吉他。
那一刻，我觉得我是世界上最幸运的孩子。
我训练非常刻苦，几乎每天花好几个小时练习弹吉他。
毕业后，我在一家舞蹈俱乐部工作。
那时我正在为我的歌曲写歌词，但没有人对它们给予任何关注。
事情进展得并不顺利。
我没有灰心丧气。
我坚持唱歌。
我把我的磁带送给了一位著名的音乐家。
他很喜欢并鼓励了我。
渐渐地，我开始受到欢迎，越来越多的人喜欢我的歌。

questions.grammar_point_name: 转折并列连词 (but)
questions.explanation: 句意：我的父母并不富裕，但我们家里总是有音乐相伴。前后两句语义构成转折关系，用连词 but。故填 but。
questions.rule_summary: 表示前后语义转折对比时，使用并列连词 but。

questions.grammar_point_name: 可数名词变复数 (唱片 records)
questions.explanation: 句意：播放甲壳虫乐队的唱片。record 在此处意为“唱片”，是可数名词，此处表泛指多张唱片，用复数形式 records。故填 records。
questions.rule_summary: record 作“唱片”解为可数名词，泛指时使用复数形式 records。

questions.grammar_point_name: 固定句型搭配 (be supposed to do)
questions.explanation: 句意：大家就理应认为我知道几百首歌的歌词。be supposed to do sth. 为固定句型，意为“理应做某事，被期望做某事”，had been 之后用过去分词 supposed。故填 supposed。
questions.rule_summary: be supposed to do sth. 为固定搭配，意为“应该，理应做某事”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 人称代词主格变宾格
questions.explanation: 句意：看到我并笑了起来。seeing 为现在分词充当状语，其后接宾语代词，I 转换为宾格 me。故填 me。
questions.rule_summary: 非谓语动词分词（seeing）后接人称代词作宾语，必须使用宾格 me。

questions.grammar_point_name: 不定冠词 (an)
questions.explanation: 句意：胳膊下夹着一把电吉他回到家里。泛指“一把电吉他”，electric 以元音音素 /ɪ/ 开头，用不定冠词 an。故填 an。
questions.rule_summary: 修饰以元音音素开头的单数可数名词时，不定冠词用 an。

questions.grammar_point_name: 动词短语搭配 (use sth. to do sth.)
questions.explanation: 句意：我期盼你能用这把吉他实现你的梦想。use sth. to do sth. 为固定搭配，意为“使用某物去做某事”，用不定式 to achieve。故填 to achieve。
questions.rule_summary: use sth. to do sth. 意为“用某物做某事”，后接动词不定式表目的。

questions.grammar_point_name: 形容词最高级 (the luckiest)
questions.explanation: 句意：那一刻，我觉得我是世界上最幸运的孩子。名词 luck 派生形容词为 lucky，后有范围 in the world，且前面有 the，需用形容词最高级 luckiest（辅音+y变iest）。故填 luckiest。
questions.rule_summary: 根据 in the world 范围状语和定冠词 the，形容词用最高级形式（lucky -> luckiest）。

questions.grammar_point_name: 动词固定句型 (spend time doing sth.)
questions.explanation: 句意：几乎每天花好几个小时练习弹吉他。spend time doing sth. 为固定搭配，意为“花费时间做某事”，需用动名词形式 practising。故填 practising。
questions.rule_summary: spend + 时间/金钱 + (in) doing sth. 为固定句型，动词用 -ing 形式。

questions.grammar_point_name: 形容词变副词 (修饰动词 go)
questions.explanation: 句意：事情进展得并不顺利。修饰不及物动词 go（进展），应用副词 smoothly 作状语。故填 smoothly。
questions.rule_summary: things go smoothly 意为“事情进展顺利”，修饰动词 go 用副词 smoothly。

questions.grammar_point_name: 动词介词搭配 (stick to)
questions.explanation: 句意：我坚持唱歌。stick to sth./doing sth. 为固定搭配，意为“坚持，忠于（原则/习惯等）”。故填 to。
questions.rule_summary: stick to doing sth. 意为“坚持做某事”，to 为介词后接动名词。

Getting over these problems by themselves can make them more independent and face the future life better.
filled_text_cn: 凭借其独特的魅力，哈尔滨在社交媒体上变得越来越受欢迎。
在这些美丽的风景中，有一群来自广西壮族自治区南宁市的十一名可爱儿童。
他们勇敢地开启了前往哈尔滨的研学之旅，迅速赢得了广大网民的心。
他们身穿亮橙色的衣服，被大家亲切地称为“小砂糖橘”。
这个绰号代表了他们可爱的橙色衣服以及广西著名的砂糖橘特产。
每天，他们有趣的旅程都受到成千上万人的关注。
无论他们走到哪里，都受到当地人的热烈欢迎。
在哈尔滨，他们品尝了当地的美味佳肴，并在冰雪大世界观看了烟花表演。
在祖国最北端的警务室，他们与战士们一起唱响国歌，这是他们研学之旅中意义非凡的一部分。
其中一名孩子的家长对东北朋友们的支持与关照表达了感谢。
孩子们穿橙色外套主要出于安全考量而被选用。
如此贴心的举措切实让家长们感到踏实放心。
这次活动为孩子们提供了一种人生经历，使他们变得更加坚强、更加自信。
在旅途中，他们可能需要面对诸如语言障碍和交通困难等许多问题。
依靠自己克服这些问题能让他们更加独立，更好地面对未来的生活。

questions.grammar_point_name: 名词派生形容词 (love -> lovely)
questions.explanation: 句意：十一名可爱的孩子。修饰名词 children 作定语，名词 love 对应的形容词为 lovely，意为“可爱的”。故填 lovely。
questions.rule_summary: 名词 love 后加 -ly 构成形容词 lovely，意为“可爱的”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 目的地介词 (trip to ...)
questions.explanation: 句意：他们开启了去往哈尔滨的研学之旅。a trip to ... 为固定搭配，介词 to 表示旅行的目的地。故填 to。
questions.rule_summary: a trip / visit / journey to + 地点，表示“前往某地的旅行”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词时态与主谓一致（一般现在时第三人称单数）
questions.explanation: 句意：这个昵称代表了他们可爱的橙色衣服和广西著名的砂糖橘产业。陈述客观事实，主语 This nickname 为第三人称单数，谓语动词加 -s 为 stands。故填 stands。
questions.rule_summary: stand for 意为“代表，象征”，陈述常态含义时用一般现在时第三人称单数 stands。

questions.grammar_point_name: 形容词转化为名词复数 (locals 当地人)
questions.explanation: 句意：他们受到了当地人的热烈欢迎。the locals 为常用复数名词短语，意为“当地人，本地居民”。故填 locals。
questions.rule_summary: 形容词 local 可转化为名词 local（当地居民），用复数形式 locals 表示群体。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词时态（一般过去时）
questions.explanation: 句意：他们与战士们一起唱响了国歌。叙述研学旅行过程中过去发生的具体事件，与前文 tasted, watched 呼应，动词 sing 的过去式为 sang。故填 sang。
questions.rule_summary: sing 的过去式为不规则变化 sang，过去分词为 sung。

questions.grammar_point_name: 谓语动词语态（一般过去时的被动语态）
questions.explanation: 句意：孩子们穿橙色外套主要是出于安全考量而被选用的。主语 The use 为不可数抽象名词，与 choose 之间是被动关系，且发生在行前过去的选择，用 was chosen。故填 was chosen。
questions.rule_summary: 主语为 The use（单数形式）且动作在过去被完成，被动语态用 was + 过去分词 chosen。

questions.grammar_point_name: 形容词变副词 (修饰动词 provided)
questions.explanation: 句意：这种关爱的举措切实让家长们感到安心。修饰现在完成时谓语 have provided，需用形容词 true 对应的副词 truly 作状语。故填 truly。
questions.rule_summary: 形容词 true 去 e 加 -ly 构成副词 truly，意为“确实，真正地”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 形容词比较级 (与more confident并列)
questions.explanation: 句意：这使他们变得更加坚强、更加自信。与 and 后面的比较级 more confident 保持并列对称，strong 的比较级为 stronger。故填 stronger。
questions.rule_summary: and 连接两个并列成分，比较级与比较级保持结构对称（stronger and more confident）。

questions.grammar_point_name: 实义动词用法 (need to do)
questions.explanation: 句意：他们可能需要面对诸如语言障碍等许多问题。need 此处在情态动词 may 后充当实义动词原形，表达“需要做某事”时接不定式 need to do sth.。故填 to face。
questions.rule_summary: need 作实义动词时，接动词不定式 need to do sth.，表示“需要做某事”。

questions.grammar_point_name: 反身代词固定短语 (by themselves)
questions.explanation: 句意：依靠他们自己克服这些问题……by oneself 为固定搭配，意为“靠某人自己，独立地”，they 对应的反身代词为 themselves。故填 themselves。
questions.rule_summary: by oneself 意为“独自，凭某人自己”，复数第三人称用 by themselves。
